This figure presents two side-by-side stacked bar charts, labeled (a) and (b), illustrating the distribution of first-level semantic domains for verbs in different Chinese text genres. Chart (a) is titled "各语体中支配动词的一级语义域分布" (distribution of first-level semantic domains of governing verbs across registers), and chart (b) is titled "各语体中承受动词的一级语义域分布" (distribution of first-level semantic domains of patient verbs across registers).

In both charts, the horizontal axis contains four genre categories: 新闻 (news), 传统文学 (traditional literature), 网络小说 (online novels), and 微博 (microblog). The vertical axis is labeled 频次 (frequency) and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, with tick marks at intervals of 1000. Each bar is a stacked bar composed of multiple colored segments representing different semantic domain categories, as indicated by a legend in the upper-right area of each chart. The legend includes categories such as 时间 (time), 空间 (space), 人物 (person), 事物 (thing), 心理活动 (psychological activity), and several others, each represented by distinct colors including dark blue, light blue, red, green, brown, and other shades.

In chart (a), the bar for 新闻 reaches approximately 4400, 传统文学 approximately 1800, 网络小说 approximately 6700 (the tallest), and 微博 approximately 6200. Percentage annotations appear on several segments within each bar, such as 10%, 57%, 67%, 61%, and 70%, indicating the proportion of the dominant dark blue segment. In chart (b), the bars are generally shorter: 新闻 reaches approximately 730, 传统文学 approximately 860, 网络小说 approximately 4520 (again the tallest), and 微博 approximately 1000. Percentage labels such as 57% and others are also annotated on certain segments. In both charts, the dominant segment across all genres appears to be a dark blue category, which consistently occupies the largest proportion of each bar. The bars are not sorted by value but rather arranged in a fixed genre order across both charts.
